'''April 2000 Rochester tournament (22 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Millennium Games, Rochester, NY on 22 April 2000. [[Chris Janiak]] won it. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d586">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-23-look-ma-no-notes-roche-ny-4-22d586/ look-ma-no-notes-roche-ny-4-22], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 23 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-23-look-ma-no-notes-roche-ny-4-22d586/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Millennium Games, Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Janiak]]
